## Goal
- Execute a full P0 end-to-end IVX IA Senior Developer QA run and build a direct-download IVX-branded Android APK.

## Constraints & Preferences
- **Expo/React Native is the ACTIVE Phase 1 production app** — `expo/` is active, `backend/` is active production backend
- **Kotlin `android-ivx-holdings/` was previously preserved/inactive** — owner has now explicitly demanded the IVX APK, overriding the earlier "don't touch Kotlin" constraint
- Owner-only autonomous endpoints require `IVX_OWNER_TOKEN` bearer authentication
- No fabricated proof — every VERIFIED claim must have real HTTP/tool evidence
- No business data modification during QA — zero unauthorized data changes
- No credential exposure in logs or chat responses
- Landing page is static HTML/JS served from S3 (`ivxholding.com` bucket) — changes require S3 upload + CloudFront invalidation
- Rork git proxy (`git push origin main`) does NOT forward to GitHub — canonical push path is `expo/sync-github.mjs` using Git Data API

## Progress
### Done
- **QA Run `qa-b400e2f1` COMPLETED with VERIFIED status** — full report produced:
  - Final deployed SHA: `a8878385798c99400163a5d64b063c085b940247`
  - Render deploy ID: `dep-d9crcv5ckfvc73cjh5u0` — status `live`
  - Backend health: `200`, commit match confirmed, `qaRunId: qa-b400e2f1`
  - All routes verified: `/health` 200, `POST /api/ivx/owner-ai` 200, `POST /public/chat` 200, `GET /api/ivx/video-platform/feed?type=reel` 200 (8 videos), `GET /api/ivx/video-platform/home-feed` 200 (4 blocks)
  - Landing page: `https://ivxholding.com/` 200, `ivx-home-feed.js` 200, `ivx-reels.js` 200 (fresh on S3)
  - Auth tests: valid owner 200, missing/invalid/empty/anon JWT all 401
  - Backend tests: 1232 pass / 73 fail (all env-dependent Supabase/Redis/role-agent paths, not code bugs)
  - Critical unit tests: intent router 68/68, variables/credentials 87/87, execution guard 52/52
  - AI provider: `vercel_ai_gateway`, `openai/gpt-4o`, key loaded, direct gateway test 200
  - GitHub sync: commit `a887838` pushed via `sync-github.mjs` Git Data API
  - Files changed in deploy: `backend/hono.ts`, `expo/app/videos.tsx`, `expo/components/CanonicalInvestmentReelCard.tsx`, `expo/ivxholding-landing/ivx-home-feed.js`, `expo/ivxholding-landing/ivx-reels.js`
- **Expo Go APK direct link provided and verified**:
  - `https://github.com/expo/expo-go-releases/releases/download/Expo-Go-57.0.2/Expo-Go-57.0.2.apk`
  - HTTP 302 → signed GitHub release asset, content-type `application/vnd.android.package-archive`
- **Kotlin `android-ivx-holdings` build fixes applied**:
  - `gradle/libs.versions.toml`: added `ktor-client-logging` library entry
  - `app/build.gradle.kts`: attempted to add `implementation(libs.ktor.client.logging)` — edit may not have applied (needs verification)
  - `OwnerDashboardScreen.kt`: added `ActionCard` composable
- **Expo `expo/android` build fixes applied**:
  - `expo/node_modules/expo-location/android/build.gradle`: changed `classifier = 'sources'` → `archiveClassifier = "sources"`
  - `expo/android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties`: restored to Gradle 8.14.3 (downgrade to 8.6 caused expo-autolinking Kotlin compile failures)
  - `bun install` completed in `expo/` — 1339 packages including `react-native@0.81.5`

### In Progress
- **Building IVX-branded standalone APK** — two paths running:
  1. `android-ivx-holdings/` (Kotlin app, `com.rork.ivxholdings`, v1.0): Gradle build running, reached `compileReleaseKotlin` task — ktor logging references may still fail if dependency not applied
  2. `expo/android/` (React Native, SDK 54): Build reached `createBundleReleaseJsAndAssets` but stuck on Watchman `watch-project` timeout (30s+)

### Blocked
- `android-ivx-holdings` build: `IVXApiService.kt` has 9 unresolved references to `logging`/`Logging`/`logger`/`Logger`/`LogLevel` — `ktor-client-logging` dependency edit to `app/build.gradle.kts` likely did not apply
- `expo/android` build: Watchman not available in build environment, causing `createBundleReleaseJsAndAssets` to hang — need `REACT_NATIVE_NO_WATCHMAN=1` or watchman installation
- No public file hosting configured for APK upload (S3 bucket `ivxholding.com` exists but no upload script for binary APK)

## Key Decisions
- Owner demanded "I need my ivxholding apk now" — overriding earlier "don't touch Kotlin" constraint
- Switched from trying `expo/android` (React Native, blocked by Watchman) to `android-ivx-holdings` (Kotlin, closer to producing a standalone APK)
- Provided Expo Go 57.0.2 APK as interim direct link while branded build proceeds

## Next Steps
- Verify `android-ivx-holdings/app/build.gradle.kts` has `implementation(libs.ktor.client.logging)` — re-apply if missing
- Rebuild `android-ivx-holdings` with `./gradlew assembleRelease` — check `/tmp/kotlin-ivx-apk-build-v2.log`
- If build succeeds, locate APK at `android-ivx-holdings/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk`
- Upload APK to public S3 (`ivxholding.com` bucket) or GitHub release for direct download link
- If Kotlin build still fails, retry `expo/android` with `REACT_NATIVE_NO_WATCHMAN=1` env var
